# dbt-quiet-failures

> Four dbt checks for the failures that pass every other test: strict_relationships (null, empty and orphan keys),
> no_mojibake (UTF-8 read as Latin-1), still_loading (a dead source still building) and check_rerun.sh (incremental
> models that duplicate on a rerun). dbt 1.10 or later, no dependencies, proven in CI on DuckDB.

Install: add `git: "https://github.com/jpsanders/dbt-quiet-failures.git"` with `revision: 1.0.0` to packages.yml.
